description: Control catalogue v1 for automated compliance checking (ISO27001 Annex A + PDPA 2010).

controls.title: Disable SSH root login

recommendations.PARTIAL: Set PermitRootLogin no and restart SSH service.
recommendations.FAIL: Disable direct root SSH login immediately.
recommendations.UNKNOWN: Investigate why SSH evidence could not be collected.

pdpa_mapping: Security principle: protect personal data via strong access control.

controls.title: Disable SSH password authentication
controls.recommendation: Set PasswordAuthentication no in /etc/ssh/sshd_config. Use key-based authentication.
controls.pdpa_mapping: Security principle: reduce credential compromise risk.

controls.title: System logging service (rsyslog) is running
controls.recommendation: Enable and start rsyslog (or journald forwarding). Ensure logs are generated and retained.
controls.pdpa_mapping: Security principle: maintain audit trails to detect incidents.

controls.title: Authentication log file exists
controls.recommendation: Ensure /var/log/auth.log exists and SSH login events are recorded.
controls.pdpa_mapping: Security principle: keep access logs for accountability.

controls.title: UFW firewall is active
controls.recommendation: Enable UFW and allow only required ports. Example: ufw enable; ufw allow 22/tcp.
controls.iso_mapping: ISO27001 Annex A (Network Security / Configuration Management)

controls.title: No weak SSH algorithms detected
controls.recommendation: Remove weak SSH algorithms (cbc/3des/sha1/group1/group14). Use modern ciphers and KEX.
controls.pdpa_mapping: Security principle: strong cryptography protects data.

controls.title: Windows Firewall enabled for all profiles
controls.recommendation: Enable Windows Firewall for Domain/Private/Public profiles and allow only required inbound ports.

controls.title: Windows Event Log service is running
controls.recommendation: Start Windows Event Log service and ensure Security events are recorded.

controls.title: Password complexity is enabled
controls.recommendation: Enable password complexity requirements in Local Security Policy or domain policy.

controls.title: Windows Update service is running
controls.recommendation: Enable Windows Update service and apply the latest patches.

controls.title: Windows Firewall enabled for all profiles
controls.recommendation: Enable Windows Firewall for Domain/Private/Public profiles and allow only required inbound ports.

controls.title: Windows Event Log service is running
controls.recommendation: Start Windows Event Log service and ensure Security events are recorded.

controls.title: Password complexity is enabled
controls.recommendation: Enable password complexity requirements in Local Security Policy.

controls.title: Windows Update service is running
controls.recommendation: Enable Windows Update service and apply the latest patches.

controls.title: Real-time antivirus protection is enabled
controls.recommendation: Enable Microsoft Defender real-time protection and ensure signatures are up to date.
controls.pdpa_mapping: Security principle: prevent malware incidents affecting personal data.
